title: Amazon DynamoDB Stream to Amazon EventBridge using Splitter pattern
description: This pattern takes a change data capture event from DynamoDB and splits it into multiple events into EventBridge.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern takes a change data capture event from DynamoDB and splits into multiple events for EventBridge.

• 1. New order is created in DynamoDB table.
  • 2. EventBridge Pipes listens to event, and forwards to enricher.
  • 3. Enricher (Lambda function) takes event and splits it for EventBridge (target).
  • 4. EventBridge raises split events for downstream consumers..
See the README in the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
